metadata.dc:title: Insurance-Backed Offshore Liquidity: Financial Law, Trust Governance and Regulatory Visibility at the PRC-Hong Kong Interface
metadata.dc:creator: Tan, Sin Hon Albert
metadata.dc:description: A doctrinal study of how Mainland-connected value enters Hong Kong insurance, supports offshore credit and interacts with trust and company governance. The book develops relational legal analysis and examines whether authorised institutions can assemble the evidence required for a particular decision.
